Installer update: fresh install now runs the Debian linux-image-amd64 APT
installation before writing XrayR files, and aborts on kernel installation failure.
Old kernels are retained; reboot remains manual. --no-remove forbids APT removals.
The previously validated XrayR binary is unchanged (source revision above).
Installer sequencing: 3 mocked tests passed (preflight failure, kernel failure,
successful ordering). Shell syntax checks passed. Actual Debian kernel package
installation and reboot were not executed in the build environment.
